values.meaning: Magic Damage to first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: The bolt deals damage to the first two enemies hit, as a single-target line missile.
mechanics.quote: blasts a dark bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first two enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The second target hit may take slightly more damage due to missile travel.
mechanics.quote: the second hit may deal 1 damage more on enemies further along the missile's flight path

mechanics.claim: Killing an enemy grants a stack of Phenomenal Evil Power, tripled against large minions/monsters (not relevant to a single dummy target, but affects self-buff APPerStack if kills occur).
mechanics.quote: If this kills an enemy, it generates 1 stack of ''{{ai|Phenomenal Evil Power|Veigar|Phenomenal Evil}}'', tripled against large {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}
